scope: Reconcile the current LibreCAD bundled-fork roadmap/inventory and LibreCAD_3 DWG direction policy, then screen QCAD/dxflib as an optional independent 2D DXF route.

method.kind: Primary project documentation and public source review
method.evidenceBoundary: Public docs and source establish declared routes, inventory semantics, and source-level contracts only. Mutable master branches were not resolved to commit SHAs, no QCAD/dxflib runtime was executed, and no DWG/DXF semantic support or local defect is inferred. The LibrePCB/dxflib source is a public mirror and is not asserted to be byte-identical to QCAD's vendored copy.

evidence.topic: LibreCAD bundled fork as migration target, not independent oracle
observed: The bundled roadmap lists low-level DWG writer targets AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 and documents that LibreCAD exposes those save targets.
AC1032 has a dedicated writer type but inherits the AC1027 container/object path; the roadmap requires independent AC1032 evidence rather than treating inheritance as proof.
The roadmap defines completion around version-specific layout, valid reference graphs, and failure behavior, and continues to track typed/raw, owner, DataStorage, AC1032, and DXF parity gaps.
The roadmap header says last reviewed 2026-09-01/rev 1299 while the fetched file includes appended material through rev 1322, so the header alone is not a reliable snapshot identifier.
doesNotEstablish: that standalone libdxfrw has identical routes or semantics
independent format correctness or support qualification
a reproducible source state without resolving repository commit SHAs
evidence.planUse: Pin standalone and bundled-fork commits before inventory comparison. Use the fork for API/migration and target-behavior guidance; port invariants rather than copying code or treating a correlated fork as an independent oracle.

observed: The generated source inventory reports 264 named/custom DWG routes, 91 named fixed entity/object cases, 20 validated fixed entity shells, zero validated fixed object shells, 158 DXF entity names, 197 DXF object names, 524 DXF class names, and 141 callbacks.
Many inventory entries remain fixture-needed; route presence and callback counts are not semantic proof.
The adjacent reference inventory compares ACadSharp, LibreDWG, ezdxf, and ODA-spec surfaces while retaining the ODA PDF as DWG byte-layout authority.
doesNotEstablish: independent reader acceptance or 3D solid meaning
evidence.planUse: Generate a revision-paired, direction/version/entity/object/class route diff; preserve source-route status separately from generated tests, independent semantics, and native acceptance. Do not promote support from totals.

observed: Roadmap revisions 1320-1322 document removing external or provenance-unresolved DWG/DXF files and keeping authored/generated controls with provenance records.
External-only corpus tests are opt-in; an absent optional file is a skip, while actual parser/oracle failures remain failures.
doesNotEstablish: redistribution permission for any file in this checkout
that an external fixture is required to continue local implementation
evidence.planUse: Commit no new external DWG/DXF fixture. Keep locally authored/generated controls small and provenance-recorded; place external corpora in opt-in scratch paths and distinguish missing-input skip from execution failure.

observed: LibreCAD_3 documents DWG import behind WITH_DWG_IMPORT, off by default, and says DWG writing is not implemented, exposed, or planned until its evidence gates are met.
Its pinned ledger is described as 15 read claims: 11 EXPERIMENTAL, 4 PENDING_NATIVE, none PROMOTED, with unresolved blockers.
doesNotEstablish: native runtime acceptance from documentation alone
evidence.planUse: Keep route, read/write claim, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 source compatibility, and downstream 3D behavior as separate qualification axes. Preserve 2D consumers without implying that those products render or edit 3D solids.

observed: QCAD documents its DXF import/export module as based on dxflib; dxflib is callback-oriented and does not own a drawing model.
The published dxflib writer guide documents R12 and DXF 2000/2002 output and requires exact call ordering; the documentation is historical and does not pin current QCAD or its vendored dxflib copy.
The inspected public dxflib source mirror opens the file in text mode and parses group-code/value pairs. This observation is not asserted to be byte-identical to QCAD's current bundled source.
doesNotEstablish: Binary DXF, DWG, modern 3D entity, raw graph, or ACIS support
current QCAD version's supported writer boundary
a second independent vote separate from dxflib lineage
evidence.planUse: Admit only as an optional, pinned ASCII R12/AC1015 2D comparator at a composed checkpoint. If the exact current route cannot be pinned, report NOT_RUN; never add it as a dependency or fast-loop test.

nextActions: Resolve exact upstream and bundled-fork commit SHAs before generating parity inventories.
Treat source route counts only as a completeness denominator and preserve evidence levels per direction and version.
Keep AC1032 writer proof separate from AC1027 inheritance and use local ODA v5.4.1 clauses as byte-layout authority.
Preserve 2D API compatibility and use fast owning tests per slice; run broad/native/peer checks only at composed checkpoints.
Do not commit external fixture blobs; keep optional corpus paths and missing-input skips distinct from failures.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.

focusedImplementationCheck.notes: The focused run also exposed and verified fixes for R2018 outer-annotative APPID remapping/refusal and the locally generated AcDs segment alignment metadata. No external fixture or peer executable was used.
